summary: M3imic aligns robot-joint, SMPL-X and sparse end-effector references in a shared latent command for one G1 controller, with modality-specific fidelity and robustness.
title: M3imic: Learning a Versatile Whole-Body Controller for Multimodal Motion Mimicking
